name: @natlang/sem-sheet
description: Analytical spreadsheet: an exact formula DAG in TypeScript with semantic cells, classification columns promotable to crisp rules, and semantic workbook merges.

sem-sheet.description: Evaluate a Sem-Sheet workbook or merge collaborative sheet diffs from a JSON file, stdin, or --cells/--merge.

arguments.name: file
arguments.description: Path to a JSON file containing { cells?, merge?, concurrency? }.

arguments.name: cells
arguments.description: Workbook cells to evaluate in topological DAG order.

arguments.name: merge
arguments.type: { base: SheetDiff; ours: SheetDiff; theirs: SheetDiff }
arguments.description: Three-way workbook cell diffs to merge via semanticMerge.
